description: Source code for the 'positioning_measurement_procedure' class, implementing positioning measurement logic including RSRP mapping, handling MAC measurement requests, and preparing F1AP responses within a 3GPP-compliant radio system.

classes.name: positioning_measurement_procedure
classes.description: Class implementing positioning measurement procedures, including request handling, response preparation, and SRS configuration matching.

methods.name: rsrp_dbfs_to_l3_rsrp_mapping
methods.description: Maps RSRP in dBFS to L3 RSRP value according to TS 38.133, Table 10.1.6.1-1.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main operator to execute the positioning measurement procedure, handling MAC request and preparing response.

methods.name: handle_mac_meas_request
methods.description: Handles the MAC measurement request asynchronously, preparing and sending positioning measurement requests.

methods.name: prepare_f1ap_response
methods.description: Prepares the F1AP positioning measurement response based on MAC responses and requested quantities.

methods.name: prepare_mac_cell_positioning_request
methods.description: Prepares MAC cell positioning request info matching UEs with the specified cell index and SRS carrier.
